output.question: What is Tilray's short interest?
output.answer: About 19.5 million Tilray Brands (TLRY) shares were sold short as of the October 30, 2026 settlement date, which is the latest FINRA biweekly data. Altindex puts that at about 13.2% of shares outstanding (Equibles says about 14.3%), with roughly 4.76 days to cover. That is a drop of about 9.2% (around 1.98 million shares) from 21.52 million on October 15, 2026, when short interest was about 14.67% of shares outstanding and 14.91% of float (StockAnalysis).

key_facts.fact: TLRY short interest was 19,539,742 shares as of the Oct 30, 2026 settlement date, down 9.2% from the prior period; 13.22% of shares outstanding; 4.76 days to cover on 4,107,576 average daily volume
FINRA reported 19,539,742 TLRY shares sold short as of Oct 30, 2026, down 1,982,689 from the prior period; 4.76 days to cover; about 14.3% of shares outstanding
Prior period (Oct 15, 2026): 21,522,431 shares short, 4.52 days to cover
StockAnalysis shows 21.52M shares short (prior month 18.79M), 14.67% of shares outstanding, 14.91% of float, short ratio 5.15. This is the Oct 15 figure, even though the page was updated Nov 11, 2026

passages.quote: FINRA reported 19,539,742 TLRY shares sold short as of the October 30, 2026 settlement date
has 19,539,742 shares short ... down 9.2% from the prior period
The latest short interest is 21.52 million, so 14.67% of the outstanding shares have been sold short.

caveats: Short interest is reported twice a month and runs about two weeks behind. A figure for the mid-November settlement date may come out soon.

The percentages don't match across sources because they use different share counts: Altindex gives 13.22% of shares outstanding, Equibles gives about 14.3% of shares, and neither gives a % of float for Oct 30. The 14.91% of float figure is from the Oct 15 period.

Some aggregators, like StockAnalysis, still showed the Oct 15 figure of 21.52M. Older numbers such as StatMuse's 186M shares likely come from before a share consolidation, so they can't be compared directly with the current numbers.
These figures come from third-party sites that pass along FINRA data. I could not open the primary FINRA or exchange page.
